documents.title: Pilot Program: HMC AI-Use Course Policies (DRAFT)
documents.summary: College-wide pilot syllabus language defining four AI Use Levels (0: no AI; 1: time-saving only; 2: augmentative only; 3: open use), applied per course or per assignment, with tips for instructors. Included as an influential source document: Pomona College's CS AI Policy Tier System is modeled on it. Added by PI decision on 2026-10-05.
